disclaimer: A curated selection reviewed on the date shown, not a complete directory or a guarantee of in-game compatibility. Publisher dates and advertised scope are separate from that review; beta routes and game data can change. Links open the original publisher; no guide packages or addon files are redistributed here.

viewNotes.addons: This is not every addon. Choose the author's Forever file for your actual client and check its dependencies before installing.
viewNotes.guides: Compare each guide's level range, update date and beta limitations. A published route or build is not a promise that every step has been tested in the current game.

addons.name: Questie
addons.rationale: Quest objectives, map markers and quest tracking.
limitations: Forever data and fixes remain in active development.
A quest helper, not a complete optimized leveling route.

addons.name: Leatrix Plus
addons.rationale: Optional looting, vendor, quest and interface conveniences.
limitations: Choose the Forever file; other game flavors are separate.
Enable only the modules you want; features can overlap other addons.

addons.name: Leatrix Maps
addons.rationale: Optional world-map scaling, positioning and map conveniences.
limitations: Select the Forever file and check overlap with other map addons.

addons.name: Auctionator
addons.rationale: Auction-house pricing, buying and posting tools.
limitations: Prices depend on actual scans and your market; not a profit guarantee.

addons.name: Bagnon
addons.rationale: A combined inventory window and bag searching.
limitations: An alternative to other bag replacements; choose one main bag interface.

addons.name: Baganator
addons.rationale: Categorized or single-view inventory management.
limitations: Requires Syndicator, as the author documents.
An alternative to Bagnon, not a requirement to install both.

addons.name: TomTom
addons.rationale: Coordinate waypoints and navigation assistance.
limitations: Coordinates and supplied routes still need the correct game data.

addons.name: Details! Damage Meter
addons.rationale: Combat analysis for damage, healing and encounters.
limitations: Publisher compatibility is not an independent test of every combat feature.

addons.name: Deadly Boss Mods Core
addons.rationale: Encounter warnings and boss-mod framework.
limitations: A compatible core does not establish complete new-Forever encounter modules.
Choose an encounter suite that covers the content you actually play.

addons.name: BigWigs
addons.rationale: An alternative encounter warning and timer suite.
limitations: A compatible core does not establish complete new-Forever encounter modules.
An alternative to DBM; check the author's required modules.

addons.name: RestedXP Guides
addons.rationale: Step-by-step leveling routes and developing dungeon routing.
limitations: The addon is free; expanded guide packages are paid.
The publisher reported levels 1–35 complete on October 9; testing above the beta cap remains limited.
Check the publisher's current package contents and price; full 1–60 coverage is not assured.

addons.name: Guidelime + TUGs
addons.rationale: Free route-following addon and a separate guide module.
limitations: Also install Guidelime; the addon and guide are separate projects.
TUGs says levels 12–30 were beta-written; 30–60 currently includes a Classic fallback pending Forever updates.

addons.name: Olympus Guild
addons.rationale: A shared in-game view of Olympus guilds, leaders and census reports.
addons.sourceKind: Author project and addon API documentation (reviewed 2026-10-21)
limitations: Optional for website readers; no desktop companion is needed.
Separate from Olympus Verify and the Army QR reporting addon.
In-game census coverage depends on reports received by the addon; it is not proof that every guild has a current website report.
addons.integrationNote: The supported addon API asks for the player's permission. It offers profile, rankings and other documented in-game features, but no guild census feed for this website.

addons.name: Forever Quest Tint
addons.rationale: Highlights quests absent from its original-Classic baseline.
limitations: The author acknowledges possible Classic-baseline omissions; tint is not official confirmation.
Overlaps the quest-highlighting features of ForeverChanges.

addons.name: ForeverChanges
addons.rationale: Highlights new or changed quests, items and spells against Classic.
limitations: Baseline comparisons can be corrected as beta data changes.
Avoid enabling overlapping quest tint effects unintentionally.

addons.name: Forever Goal Tracker
addons.rationale: Long-term goals, step-by-step progress and cross-character tracking.
limitations: Goal inclusion is not proof that every future item or activity is currently obtainable.

addons.name: Forever Quest Pins
addons.rationale: Quest map assistance built for Forever.
limitations: Compare overlap with Questie before choosing your map setup.

addons.name: Forever Statistics
addons.rationale: Character and play statistics for Forever.
limitations: Review the author's local data and export features before enabling them.

addons.name: ForeverForge
addons.rationale: Modular convenience suite with a shared settings interface.
limitations: Modules overlap bag, auction, quest and interface addons; select features deliberately.

addons.name: Forever Unit Frames
addons.rationale: Unit and raid-frame interface for Forever.
limitations: Check compatibility with your other frame replacements and beta client.

addons.name: ForeverAuras
addons.rationale: A Forever aura framework fork.
limitations: Under development during beta; not a guarantee that existing WeakAuras imports work.
Inspect third-party aura code and the author's current limitations.

guides.name: Wowhead Forever
guides.rationale: Named class writers, talent and gearing reference.
guides.scope: Current level-30 beta, with page-specific dates and builds
limitations: Check each guide's date and activity; no final endgame-meta promise.
Some pages need JavaScript to display their full directory.

guides.name: Icy Veins Forever
guides.rationale: Structured explanations for all nine classes and live profession pages.
guides.scope: Page-specific beta builds, levels and changelogs
limitations: Check the date on each guide; the directory's date may differ.
Review and testing vary by article. Do not assume every profession route has been tested through skill 300.

guides.name: WoW-Professions Forever
guides.rationale: Practical leveling routes, material lists, trainers and camping.
guides.status: Published routes with explicit untested sections
guides.scope: Forever professions; later skill ranges may be provisional
limitations: The Alchemy 225–300 route explicitly remains untested under the beta cap.
Material costs depend on your server's actual supply and prices.

guides.name: Method Forever
guides.rationale: Nine class-leveling directories, travel references and available dungeon walkthroughs.
guides.scope: Check the individual route or dungeon page
limitations: Some listed dungeons may not have a complete walkthrough.
Level-60 route outlines may include sections that have not been tested in beta.

guides.name: Mobalytics Forever
guides.rationale: Creator-authored professions, class and patch explanations.
limitations: Distinguish editorial articles from community submissions.
Later profession routes remain subject to beta restrictions.

guides.name: Warcraft Tavern Forever
guides.rationale: Supplemental class and leveling guidance with identifiable authors.
guides.status: Directory listed; article contents not reviewed
guides.scope: Review the article's current date and level range
limitations: The directory listing was found on the review date, but its current articles could not be read. Open the publisher to check their scope and availability.

guides.name: Blizzard Forever Deep Dive
guides.rationale: The announced camping, Legacy, profession and world systems.
guides.scope: Announcements, not an optimized class build
limitations: Later official development notes can supersede announced details.

guides.name: The Forever Era
guides.rationale: Independent data, comparisons and talent/gear tools.
guides.scope: Check build and source labels on each tool
limitations: Its BiS tool discloses indicative weights with no simulations, unscored procs/set bonuses and Classic-derived sources.

guides.name: Classic WoW Forever
guides.rationale: Dated comparisons and system/profession explanations with methodology disclosure.
guides.scope: Page-specific beta build and comparison date
limitations: Discloses AI assistance and a responsible editor.
Recipe counts are dated database findings, not final Blizzard-confirmed totals.

guides.name: Forever Codex
guides.rationale: Additional reference data with source/status disclosures.
guides.status: Accessible fallback is older; live status needs JavaScript
limitations: Do not infer that every page is current with every beta build.

guides.name: RestedXP route progress
guides.rationale: Publisher's dated explanation of the Forever route work.
guides.scope: Publisher reports 1–35 complete; dungeon routing developing
limitations: The playable beta cap limits normal testing above level 30.
Check current package contents and pricing with the publisher before purchasing.

guides.name: Zygor Forever
guides.rationale: Track the publisher's announced guide availability.
guides.status: Listed as coming soon on the review date
guides.scope: Publisher warns the launch 1–60 experience may be partially updated
limitations: Check release status before purchasing; announced features may not yet be available or fully tested.
